source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 345 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 345 was established by Ordinance No. 20851, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 9, 1991. Ordinance No. 20851 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 345 is established on property generally located along the northwest line of Royal Lane, northwest of the northwest line of Ashcroft Avenue. The size of PD 345 is approximately 19.421 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Detailed Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.104. DETAILED DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development on the Property must comply with the detailed development plan (Exhibit 345A). (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.105. SUBDIVISION PLAT.

Before the issuance of any building permit on the Property, a final subdivision plat must be approved by the city plan commission and filed with the county clerk’s office in the county in which the Property is located. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.106. USES.

Only those uses permitted in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District as provided in Chapter 51A are permitted on the Property, subject to the same conditions applicable in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District. For example, a use only allowed in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District by specific use permit (“SUP”) is only permitted in this PD by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (“DIR”) in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District is subject to DIR in this PD; etc. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Density
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.107. DENSITY.

No more than 94 single family dwelling units are permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

Except as otherwise provided in this article, development on the Property must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations applicable to the TH-1(A) Townhouse District as provided in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.109. HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.110. SCREENING.

A minimum six-foot-high screening wall must be provided as shown on the detailed development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.111. HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION.

The screening wall required in Section 51P-345.110 shall be maintained by a homeowners’ association. An instrument creating the homeowners’ association (“the instrument”) must be submitted with the first building permit application on the Property. The instrument must be filed for record with the county clerk’s office in the county in which the Property is located. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-345.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 345 is located on Zoning Map No. E-8. (Ord. Nos. 20851; 25850)
